page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-32-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with high-speed local solid-state storage. It operates on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation stands at 120.0 GB, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The compute node incorporates an extensive L3 cache structure totaling 504 MB, alongside 48 KB L1 data and 2 MB L2 caches. Acceleration instructions include Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) and AVX-512 extensions. The server integrates 2010 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage across 5 drives and includes no discrete GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-thread and compute capabilities. Single-core performance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench (2304.0) and single-threaded gzip compression (36.97 GB/sec), supported by top-tier image processing metrics. Multi-threaded evaluations highlight solid scaling, scoring 18164.0 in Geekbench multi-core and delivering strong results in Clang software compilation and PassMark encryption. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 167.91 GB/sec, while write operations peak at 29.86 GB/sec. In memory-intensive services, it maintains strong throughput, processing 63.56 million Redis SET operations per second and sustaining 58.17 GB/sec in static web serving.

The inclusion of 2010 GB of high-throughput local NVMe storage combined with a standard 1:3.75 compute-to-memory ratio creates favorable cost efficiency for workloads constrained by I/O bottlenecks. While uncached large-block write throughput and raw stress-ng compute metrics score in the middle tiers, the platform offers significant efficiency for applications using AMX extensions and local disk caching. The server does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which may require separate networking arrangements.

This hardware profile matches demanding database operations, transactional workloads, high-concurrency Redis caching instances, CI/CD build environments, and I/O-intensive data processing pipelines requiring direct, low-latency disk access.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-32-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine engineered for I/O-intensive and data-heavy environments. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz, it features 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 120.0 GB of memory, and 2010 GB of attached local NVMe SSD storage across five drives without discrete GPUs. Hardware support covers Intel AMX and AVX-512 vector acceleration alongside a 504 MB L3 cache. Synthetic and application testing demonstrates top-tier single-core Geekbench and compression metrics, complemented by strong Clang compilation and 63.56 million Redis SET operations per second. Memory throughput reaches 167.91 GB/sec on uncached reads. Combining dense local storage with solid multi-core performance, this server is suitable for transactional database engines, continuous integration build clusters, low-latency caching tiers, and static web serving.
